alu_iadd3.description: 3-source ALU (IADD3, IMAD, FFMA) — Rc2 in hi[7:0]

alu_simple.description: 2-source ALU (MOV, SEL, IADD, FADD, FMUL, conversions, comparisons)

s2r.description: System register read — hi[15:8] = SR code (opcode extension, not scheduling)

ldc.description: 32-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

ldc64.description: 64-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0xa is type discriminator

ldcu64.description: 64-bit uniform constant bank load — bit43=1 required

ldg.description: Global memory load (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed discriminators

stg.description: Global memory store (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed, upper 32 has write/wait

lds.description: Shared memory load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

sts.description: Shared memory store — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

barrier.description: Barrier / sync / membar — no scheduling bits

ctrl_flow.description: Control flow (BRA, CALL, RET, BSSY, BSYNC, etc.) — no standard scheduling

exit_static.description: EXIT — fully static ctrl word, bit43 required

nop.description: NOP — fully static, no write/wait mask allowed
